I told Pree in a thread reply on her #central-random message that the ticket is #8841.

The source is Tobias's message in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she can see it herself.

Tobias didn't name the customer. He called it his "dealer account". I linked that to Marrow Fieldworks through the Central handoff note from January, which says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan and was then Pree's dealer account. That fits with Tobias holding it now, but it's an inference, not something anyone stated.

I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, the old Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 ticket. I couldn't find a ticket file for this account, so I couldn't check the ticket's current status. I pointed her to Tobias for that.
